description: This file is a React component implementing a Dashboard page for a career navigation frontend. It manages state, fetches user data, KPIs, evidence, and gap analysis, and renders the dashboard UI including KPIs, gaps, evidence, and quick actions.

methods.name: deriveTraffic
methods.description: Determines traffic light color based on profile level and target.

methods.name: normalizeBreakdown
methods.description: Normalizes raw gap breakdown data into GapRow objects.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Main data loading function that fetches user data, profile, evidence, KPIs, and gap analysis.

methods.name: onRefreshKpis
methods.description: Refreshes KPI and gap data on user request.

methods.name: onExportPdf
methods.description: Exports the user profile as a PDF document.

methods.name: chip
methods.description: Renders a small info chip UI element with label and value.

methods.name: trafficDot
methods.description: Displays a colored dot indicating traffic status.
